description: Golden scenarios for the TOON machine-data rule. Cases with enforcedBy are checked by the named deterministic test; the rest are live-only and not run. Dataset presence and JSON validity do not prove model behavior.

cases.input: A phase must create a new machine-read record file that an agent will load into context on later runs, a list of 40 uniform entries. Which format?
expected: TOON, using a tabular array for the uniform entries
Name the rule in ai-framework/rules/ as the owner
forbidden: Plain JSON because it is more familiar

cases.input: Convert .claude/settings.json to TOON to save tokens.
expected: Refuse: host-native files stay in the host's format
Point at the rule's scope list

cases.input: graphify-out/graph.json is 5 MB. Convert it to TOON to cut ingestion tokens.
expected: Decline: agents query it through graphify.mts and never load it, so there is no ingestion cost to save
forbidden: Claim token savings without a measurement

cases.input: eval-runner is given the same dataset once as JSON and once as TOON.
expected: Same cases, same verdicts and the same regression deltas
forbidden: Different case count or dropped fields between formats

cases.input: Convert the real eval datasets to TOON and read them back.
expected: Every value, key and array is deep-equal to the JSON source
forbidden: Any dropped field, changed type or reordered array
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/toon-convert.test.mts: each real dataset converts in a temp copy and reads back deep-equal

cases.input: A data file exists as both .toon and .json.
expected: Every reader refuses with a both-present error
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/data-file.test.mts: both a .toon and a .json present is an error

cases.input: A table header says 3 rows but 2 follow, or an inline array says 2 values but holds 1.
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/toon-data.test.mts: array size must match rows, items and inline values

cases.input: Values "007", "true", "null", "1e3", "12" are strings; 12, true, null are real.
expected: Strings stay strings and real values stay typed after a round trip
forbidden: Turning a number into a string
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/toon-data.test.mts: strings that look like other types stay strings; real numbers and booleans do not become strings

cases.input: Values with commas, colons, quotes, #, brackets, edge spaces, empty strings, newlines and unicode.
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/toon-data.test.mts: commas, colons, quotes, hash, brackets, spaces, newlines, empty and unicode round trip

cases.input: Objects share keys in a different order, or one is missing a key.
expected: Written as a list; never a misaligned table
forbidden: A table whose columns do not line up with every row
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/toon-data.test.mts: non-uniform objects, key order and missing keys fall back to a list

cases.input: Given a 40-row TOON table, what is the `reason` of the 27th entry, and how many entries have status `extracted`?
expected: The exact value and count from the source
forbidden: Reading a neighbouring row or column

cases.input: Run the converter report on a small or non-uniform file where TOON does not shrink it.
expected: The report says larger, mixed or no saving and names its proxies
forbidden: Claiming a token saving the report did not print

cases.input: A data file is malformed, oversize, a symlink or not UTF-8.
expected: Reader refuses; writer will not overwrite it
forbidden: Treating it as missing and writing a fresh file
enforcedBy: ai-framework/scripts/runtime/data-file.test.mts: a damaged or hostile file is refused, never absent; never overwrites a file the reader refuses

executionNote: enforced-by-test means a repository test covers the behavior; it is not an LLM eval result.
